id: title:Gilbert09:stop the connection drop probe rollback masking the real error

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion discovery and connection recovery
review.reason: Adds a check for connection-drop or connection-limit errors before executing a rollback, and re-raises the original error instead of rolling back a potentially dead connection.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the observed implementation of a specific error-handling improvement. observations.behavior: Adds a check for connection-drop or connection-limit errors before executing a rollback, and re-raises the original error instead of rolling back a potentially dead connection.
observations.posthog_connection: This prevents the warehouse ingestion discovery path from masking the root cause of a connection failure. When the PostgreSQL server closes the connection, the previous implementation would attempt a rollback on a dead socket, raising a misleading 'connection lost' error.
